stanzas.sanskrit:
प्रागेवाचार्यपुत्राहृतिनिशमनया स्वीयषट्सूनुवीक्षां
काङ्क्षन्त्या मातुरुक्त्या सुतलभुवि बलिं प्राप्य तेनार्चितस्त्वम् ।
धातुः शापाद्धिरण्यान्वितकशिपुभवान् शौरिजान् कंसभग्ना-
-नानीयैनान् प्रदर्श्य स्वपदमनयथाः पूर्वपुत्रान्मरीचेः ॥ ८८-१ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en:
Earlier, Krishna had brought back the life of Guru Sandipani's son and returned him to his Guru as Guru dakshina. Knowing this, Devaki requested Krishna to show her six children born to her who got killed by Kamsa.
Krishna went to Suthala, where he was honoured by Mahabali.
Krishna brought back the six sons who were originally Marichi's sons and were later born to Hiranyakashipu by a curse of Brahma and later they were born as Vasudeva's children. Krishna sent them to Devaloka.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
prāgevācāryaputrāhṛtiniśamanayā svīyaṣaṭsūnuvīkṣāṃ
kāṅkṣantyā māturuktyā sutalabhuvi baliṃ prāpya tenārcitastvam |
dhātuḥ śāpāddhiraṇyānvitakaśipubhavān śaurijān kaṃsabhagnā-
-nānīyainān pradarśya svapadamanayathāḥ pūrvaputrānmarīceḥ || 88-1 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
श्रुतदेव इति श्रुतं द्विजेन्द्रं
बहुलाश्वं नृपतिं च भक्तिपूर्णम् ।
युगपत्त्वमनुग्रहीतुकामो
मिथिलां प्रापिथ तापसैः समेतः ॥ ८८-२ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: With the desire to bless both the great well known Braahmina Shrutadeva and the deeply devoted king Bahulaswa, Bhagwan went to Mithila.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
śrutadeva iti śrutaṃ dvijendraṃ
bahulāśvaṃ nṛpatiṃ ca bhaktipūrṇam |
yugapattvamanugrahītukāmo
mithilāṃ prāpitha tāpasaiḥ sametaḥ || 88-2 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
गच्छन् द्विमूर्तिरुभयोर्युगपन्निकेत-
-मेकेन भूरिविभवैर्विहितोपचारः ।
अन्येन तद्दिनभृतैश्च फलौदनाद्यै-
-स्तुल्यं प्रसेदिथ ददाथ च मुक्तिमाभ्याम् ॥ ८८-३ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Bahulaswa being a king, offered a grand welcome and pooja with gold and expensive items whereas Sruthadeva offered fruits, vegetables available on that day and performed Pooja. Krishna blessed both of them equally and gave them moksham.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
gacchan dvimūrtirubhayoryugapanniketa-
-mekena bhūrivibhavairvihitopacāraḥ |
anyena taddinabhṛtaiśca phalaudanādyai-
-stulyaṃ praseditha dadātha ca muktimābhyām || 88-3 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
भूयोऽथ द्वारवत्यां द्विजतनयमृतिं तत्प्रलापानपि त्वं
को वा दैवं निरुन्ध्यादिति किल कथयन् विश्ववोढाऽप्यसोढाः ।
जिष्णोर्गर्वं विनेतुं त्वयि मनुजधिया कुण्ठितां चास्य बुद्धिं
तत्त्वारूढां विधातुं परमतमपदप्रेक्षणेनेति मन्ये ॥ ८८-४ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Then in Dwaraka, there was a Braahmin whose children died just when they were born. His family was crying about the loss for which Krishna said that no one can go against destiny. Actually Krishna wanted to remove the pride of Arjuna and change his immature thought that Krishna is just a human like himself, show him the vaikuntam and make him realise that Krishna is Paramatma Swaroopam. Hence he acted as if he neglected the brahmin's complaint.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
bhūyo’tha dvāravatyāṃ dvijatanayamṛtiṃ tatpralāpānapi tvaṃ
ko vā daivaṃ nirundhyāditi kila kathayan viśvavoḍhā’pyasoḍhāḥ |
jiṣṇorgarvaṃ vinetuṃ tvayi manujadhiyā kuṇṭhitāṃ cāsya buddhiṃ
tattvārūḍhāṃ vidhātuṃ paramatamapadaprekṣaṇeneti manye || 88-4 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
नष्टा अष्टास्य पुत्राः पुनरपि तव तूपेक्षया कष्टवादः
स्पष्टो जातो जनानामथ तदवसरे द्वारकामाप पार्थः ।
मैत्र्या तत्रोषितोऽसौ नवमसुतमृतौ विप्रवर्यप्ररोदं
श्रुत्वा चक्रे प्रतिज्ञामनुपहृतसुतः सन्निवेक्ष्ये कृशानुम् ॥ ८८-५ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Like this, the brahmin got eight children and all of them died. People in Dwaraka began to speak that such sorrows happen only due to Krishna's indifference to the brahmin's woes. Around that time, Arjuna who came to Dwaraka got to know the brahmin's grief & made a vow that he would bring back his children, else would jump into the fire.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
naṣṭā aṣṭāsya putrāḥ punarapi tava tūpekṣayā kaṣṭavādaḥ
spaṣṭo jāto janānāmatha tadavasare dvārakāmāpa pārthaḥ |
maitryā tatroṣito’sau navamasutamṛtau vipravaryaprarodaṃ
śrutvā cakre pratijñāmanupahṛtasutaḥ sannivekṣye kṛśānum || 88-5 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
मानी स त्वामपृष्ट्वा द्विजनिलयगतो बाणजालैर्महास्त्रै-
-रुन्धानः सूतिगेहं पुनरपि सहसा दृष्टनष्टे कुमारे ।
याम्यामैन्द्रीं तथान्याः सुरवरनगरीर्विद्ययाऽऽसाद्य सद्यो
मोघोद्योगः पतिष्यन् हुतभुजि भवता सस्मितं वारितोऽभूत् ॥ ८८-६ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Thinking that he is the protector of people who come to him, Arjuna without even asking Krishna, went to the brahmin's house and protected the delivery room with row of arrows and still the Brahmin lost his baby. Arjuna went to Yama, Indra loka with his yogic powers and searched for the children but in vain. When he tried to jump into the fire to keep up his vow, Krishna prevented him.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
mānī sa tvāmapṛṣṭvā dvijanilayagato bāṇajālairmahāstrai-
-rundhānaḥ sūtigehaṃ punarapi sahasā dṛṣṭanaṣṭe kumāre |
yāmyāmaindrīṃ tathānyāḥ suravaranagarīrvidyayā”sādya sadyo
moghodyogaḥ patiṣyan hutabhuji bhavatā sasmitaṃ vārito’bhūt || 88-6 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
सार्धं तेन प्रतीचीं दिशमतिजविना स्यन्दनेनाभियातो
लोकालोकं व्यतीतस्तिमिरभरमथो चक्रधाम्ना निरुन्धन् ।
चक्रांशुक्लिष्टदृष्टिं स्थितमथ विजयं पश्य पश्येति वारां
पारे त्वं प्राददर्शः किमपि हि तमसां दूरदूरं पदं ते ॥ ८८-७ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Krishna took Arjuna quickly in his chariot in the west direction to Loka lokam, which was dark. Krishna using his sudarshana chakra removed the darkness and facilitated Arjuna to see Vaikunta, Krishna's abode. Arjuna's eyes were dazzled.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
sārdhaṃ tena pratīcīṃ diśamatijavinā syandanenābhiyāto
lokālokaṃ vyatītastimirabharamatho cakradhāmnā nirundhan |
cakrāṃśukliṣṭadṛṣṭiṃ sthitamatha vijayaṃ paśya paśyeti vārāṃ
pāre tvaṃ prādadarśaḥ kimapi hi tamasāṃ dūradūraṃ padaṃ te || 88-7 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
तत्रासीनं भुजङ्गाधिपशयनतले दिव्यभूषायुधाद्यै-
-रावीतं पीतचेलं प्रतिनवजलदश्यामलं श्रीमदङ्गम् ।
मूर्तीनामीशितारं परमिह तिसृणामेकमर्थं श्रुतीनां
त्वामेव त्वं परात्मन् प्रियसखसहितो नेमिथ क्षेमरूपम् ॥ ८८-८ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Arjuna saw Krishna, who is greatest among trinities and who is the originator of Vedas and scriptures, lying on bed made by Aadhiseshan, completely decked with jewellery and holding weapons, with Mahalakshmi in HIS chest. Arjuna saw Krishna as the supreme form there and prostrated.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
tatrāsīnaṃ bhujaṅgādhipaśayanatale divyabhūṣāyudhādyai-
-rāvītaṃ pītacelaṃ pratinavajaladaśyāmalaṃ śrīmadaṅgam |
mūrtīnāmīśitāraṃ paramiha tisṛṇāmekamarthaṃ śrutīnāṃ
tvāmeva tvaṃ parātman priyasakhasahito nemitha kṣemarūpam || 88-8 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
युवां मामेव द्वावधिकविवृतान्तर्हिततया
विभिन्नौ सन्द्रष्टुं स्वयमहमहार्षं द्विजसुतान् ।
नयेतं द्रागेतानिति खलु वितीर्णान् पुनरमून्
द्विजायादायादाः प्रणुतमहिमा पाण्डुजनुषा ॥ ८८-९ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Bhagwan said the two of you are Myself alone. In one the divinity is potent (paramathma) and it is latent in the other (Jeevathma), so you two seem different. To meet you I Myself took away the sons of the Brahmin. You may now take them away.' With such words the Supreme gave away the children which Krishna gave back to the Brahmin, while Arjun sang glory.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
yuvāṃ māmeva dvāvadhikavivṛtāntarhitatayā
vibhinnau sandraṣṭuṃ svayamahamahārṣaṃ dvijasutān |
nayetaṃ drāgetāniti khalu vitīrṇān punaramūn
dvijāyādāyādāḥ praṇutamahimā pāṇḍujanuṣā || 88-9 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
एवं नानाविहारैर्जगदभिरमयन् वृष्णिवंशं प्रपुष्ण-
-न्नीजानो यज्ञभेदैरतुलविहृतिभिः प्रीणयन्नेणनेत्राः ।
भूभारक्षेपदम्भात् पदकमलजुषां मोक्षणायावतीर्णः
पूर्णं ब्रह्मैव साक्षाद्यदुषु मनुजतारूषितस्त्वं व्यलासीः ॥ ८८-१० ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Like this, Krishna through HIS leelas delighted the world, made the vrishni clan prosper, pleased the beautiful eyed wives with HIS activities and helped brahmins perform yagnas. HE liberated many devotees who surrendered at HIS lotus feet and helped them cross the ocean of Samsara, which was the main reason for HIS incarnation. Krishna appeared in human form amongst the yadava clan.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
evaṃ nānāvihārairjagadabhiramayan vṛṣṇivaṃśaṃ prapuṣṇa-
-nnījāno yajñabhedairatulavihṛtibhiḥ prīṇayanneṇanetrāḥ |
bhūbhārakṣepadambhāt padakamalajuṣāṃ mokṣaṇāyāvatīrṇaḥ
pūrṇaṃ brahmaiva sākṣādyaduṣu manujatārūṣitastvaṃ vyalāsīḥ || 88-10 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
प्रायेण द्वारवत्यामवृतदयि तदा नारदस्त्वद्रसार्द्र-
-स्तस्माल्लेभे कदाचित् खलु सुकृतनिधिस्त्वत्पिता तत्त्वबोधम् ।
भक्तानामग्रयायी स च खलु मतिमानुद्धवस्त्वत्त एव
प्राप्तो विज्ञानसारं स किल जनहितायाधुनाऽस्ते बदर्याम् ॥ ८८-११ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Sage Narada, an ardent devotee of Bhagwan stayed in Dwaraka mostly. Vasudevan, virtuous father of Krishna received spiritual knowledge from Sage Narada. Uddhavar, the prime devotee and intelligent amongst all devotees of Bhagwan, attained spiritual knowledge from Krishna. He continues to stay at Bhadrikaahrama for the benefit of the world.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
prāyeṇa dvāravatyāmavṛtadayi tadā nāradastvadrasārdra-
-stasmāllebhe kadācit khalu sukṛtanidhistvatpitā tattvabodham |
bhaktānāmagrayāyī sa ca khalu matimānuddhavastvatta eva
prāpto vijñānasāraṃ sa kila janahitāyādhunā’ste badaryām || 88-11 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
सोऽयं कृष्णावतारो जयति तव विभो यत्र सौहार्दभीति-
-स्नेहद्वेषानुरागप्रभृतिभिरतुलैरश्रमैर्योगभेदैः ।
आर्तिं तीर्त्वा समस्ताममृतपदमगुः सर्वतः सर्वलोकाः
स त्वं विश्वार्तिशान्त्यै पवनपुरपते भक्तिपूर्त्यै च भूयाः ॥ ८८-१२ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en:
The incarnation of KRISHNA is one of the best incarnations where everyone overcame the sorrows and could attain spiritual union with Bhagwan effortlessly.
Pandavas with their friendship,
Kamsan through his fear,
Nandan and vasudevan through their affection,
Shishupalan through his hatred,
Gopikas through their love, attained Moksham.
Bhattathiri requested Bhagwan who incarnated for removal of sorrows. to bless him and all of us too with complete devotion.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
so’yaṃ kṛṣṇāvatāro jayati tava vibho yatra sauhārdabhīti-
-snehadveṣānurāgaprabhṛtibhiratulairaśramairyogabhedaiḥ |
ārtiṃ tīrtvā samastāmamṛtapadamaguḥ sarvataḥ sarvalokāḥ
sa tvaṃ viśvārtiśāntyai pavanapurapate bhaktipūrtyai ca bhūyāḥ || 88-12 ||
